question: Does preferring names up 1-5% on the day (instead of 8-40%) in the soft-seed seat ranking give the desk better trades per trade than the current band, and better than re-ranking the same share of names at random?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-27: 'Preregister a replay test of earlier admission: ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_min 8 -> a 1-5% band (and related seat ranking), in the late-gates replay harness, against the same desk with the current band and a matched random control.'
registered_at: 2026-10-27 evening ET, before any variant of this study is run or read.
origin: Argon (10/27): 80% of first-square signals fired before the screener admitted the stock, and names up >= 8% had a -2.15 bp median 15m return (in-sample, unverified). The lag audit (BATCH2_2026-10-24.md): the desk arms ~14 min / +24 bp after the %R turn. Code check 10/27: ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_min/max is NOT an admission gate; it is a ranking bonus inside soft_seed_scout_score (ai_entry_watch.py ~1985-2050): +25 for 'prefer' (8..40%), +8 'mid', up to +8 'below_prefer' (0.2 x pct), -10/-55 'over_soft'. It only orders soft-seed scout candidates (ai_watch_soft_seed_max 12) and is secondary to the EXH-heat score.
prior: The band changes only one admission path's ordering and is secondary to EXH heat, so it may change few seats and few trades. Every admission-gate change tested so far was ~flat (gate_counterfactual 10/23, board-names gates 10/14). Prior lift 0 +- 3 bp per trade; a real chance the treatment is near-vacuous.

variants.REF: The day's recorded config with the 10/27 desk regime pinned (late_gates_run.PIN values for presquare_only, Leg-1 OFF, ai_max_positions 5, ai_max_position_pct 20, ai_risk_pct 1.0, ai_watch_min_price 20, ai_position_slot_equity 60), the two live entry gates at their 10/27 live values (ai_watch_wr_trend_min_rise 15, ai_watch_wr_slow_5m_veto true, min_pitch 0), ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_min 8.0, ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_max 40.0, ai_watch_admit_chg_soft_max 50.0 (the current values, pinned).
variants.BAND: REF + ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_min 1.0, ai_watch_admit_chg_prefer_max 5.0 (soft_max unchanged 50). Effect in code: 1-5% names get +25; 5-50% names fall to 'mid' (+8); < 1% stay 'below_prefer'.
variants.RAND_k (k=1,2,3): REF + a NEW knob ai_watch_admit_rand_prefer_share = s and salt 'AB-k': in soft_seed_scout_score, a row whose sha256(salt|symbol|day) draw is < s is scored as band 'prefer' (+25) and every other row as 'mid' (+8), regardless of pct, unless its pct is over soft_max (that penalty still applies, as in BAND). s = that session's share of BAND's scored soft-seed rows classified 'prefer' (two-pass: BAND first). So RAND re-ranks the same share of rows into the top tier as BAND does, chosen without regard to day change. Default 0 = off, live behavior unchanged.
variants.counter: A new work-count in the replay: number of soft-seed rows scored and number classified 'prefer', per run (needed for s and for the vacuity check). Default behavior unchanged.

harness: tools/replay_session.py, the late_gates pinned flags (amended_2 #13: --start 09:00 --end 15:50 --step 2.0 --engine recorded --exits live --live-staleness, paint on, one pinned --sha for every run), outputs ~/replay_runs/admit_band/DAY-VAR.json. Same costing (full SIP spread at entry; replay ret repriced at the SIP 1m close of the entry minute for the repriced check), open_at_end marked at the SIP 15:49 close, same classify (same / delayed / removed / new vs REF).
sessions: Every recorded session with a wire recording (2026-09-28 onward; 9/24-9/25 lack it), 2026-09-28..2026-10-27 = 20 sessions, plus forward sessions to a cap of 40. Halves by count in date order.
vacuity_gate: Count step, before any mean: per session, the share of REF trades not 'same' in BAND (delayed + removed) plus BAND 'new' trades over REF trades. If the pooled changed share < 10%, the verdict is NO EFFECT ('the prefer band is not the admission lever') and nothing else is scored. Also printed: soft-seed rows scored, share 'prefer' in REF and BAND, and median minutes from a symbol's first appearance in any recorded source list to its first seat, REF vs BAND (outcome-free).
statistic: Per session: lift_ref = mean net(BAND) - mean net(REF); lift_rand = mean net(BAND) - mean over k of mean net(RAND_k); bp per trade, sessions equal-weighted, t = std_scorer.day_stat. A session needs >= 5 REF trades (pre-treatment). A session where BAND's trade list equals REF's is scored with its computed lift (0).
power: MDE per half = 3.08 x max(sd_session(mean net(RAND avg) - mean net(REF)), sd_session(mean net(MDE1) - mean net(REF))) / sqrt(sessions in the half), MDE1 = REF + rand share 0.25 salt 'AB-MDE'. Floors per half: >= 10 scored sessions, MDE <= 6 bp; else UNDERPOWERED (no means), and at the 40-session cap UNDERPOWERED = FAIL.
pass: lift_ref >= +3 bp/trade with t >= 2.0 over all scored sessions, AND lift_ref > 0 in BOTH halves, AND lift_rand > 0 with t >= 2.0, AND the repriced lift_ref (1m-close entries) also >= +3 with t >= 2.0 and > 0 in both halves, AND >= 300 REF trades and >= 300 BAND trades.
fail: lift_ref <= 0 in either half is FAIL regardless of t; anything else short of PASS is FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED / NO EFFECT as above).
information_only: Trades per session and opens per 10 minutes, REF vs BAND (the operator wants profit first, but the opens cost is reported).
Absolute mean net per variant per half.
Class split (same / delayed / removed / new) with mean net per class.
Drop top 3 sessions and top 5 names from lift_ref.
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3, then the operator decides on a live switch of the two knobs (after the close).
if_fail: Keep the band. If NO EFFECT, record that earlier admission is not reachable through this knob and that the source lists themselves (movers/trending/research arrival times) are the next place to look.
no_retuning: No other band (e.g. 0.5-5, 1-8) is scored as primary.
script: Knob + counter in ai_entry_watch.py (defaults off / unchanged), runner tools/studies/admit_band_run.py (reusing late_gates_run), scorer tools/studies/admit_band_read.py (reusing late_gates_read), written after this file is committed and after a result-skeptic READY; they may not change anything above. Runs only after the late_gates primary and info phases have finished on the mini (Alpaca budget, one batch at a time).
multiplicity: One primary. Every information line has no pass.

closed.why: Admission ranking is not the bottleneck: lag_engine_join.py (10/28) found 541 of 555 bought names already in the engine when they passed admission, and lag_admission.py put only ~0.9 min/buy in 'kept, not seated'. Never reviewed or run.
